title: Generalist Meets Specialists: An Evolving Multimodal Agent with Persistent Tool Orchestration for Traffic Scenario Understanding
title_zh: 通用模型与专用工具协作：面向交通场景理解的可演化多模态智能体与持久化工具编排
abstract_en: Traffic scenario understanding requires combining fine-grained visual evidence with spatial and temporal reasoning. Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can use specialized perception tools, but effective collaboration faces two challenges: terminal rewards provide limited guidance for intermediate decisions and error recovery, while repeated planning adds unnecessary cost across similar tasks. Echoing the fast-slow dichotomy of human cognition, we propose StarTV-Agent, which combines policy learning with experience evolution to support adaptive reasoning when needed and efficient reuse of prior experience when possible. During training, Role-Sensitive Process Optimization (RSPO) combines process advantages with terminal advantages, while Weakness-Driven Demonstration Learning (WDL) provides validated teacher demonstrations targeting the student's weak questions. During inference, Lightweight Adaptive Workflow Reuse (LAWR) enables a fast path by selecting suitable workflows and binding task-specific arguments and resource references, while a slow ReAct-based path handles tasks without suitable workflows. We further design label-free feedback based on execution completion, workflow adoption, and cost savings to guide workflow reuse and memory updates. Across three challenging benchmarks, StarTV-Agent achieves up to 8.0% relative performance improvement, while reducing token consumption by up to 52.1%.
abstract_zh: 交通场景理解需要结合细粒度视觉证据与时空推理。工具增强的视觉语言模型（VLM）虽能调用专用感知工具，但终局奖励难以指导中间决策和错误恢复，相似任务中的重复规划也会造成额外开销。受人类快慢思考机制启发，作者提出 StarTV-Agent，将策略学习与经验演化相结合：有合适的工作流时复用经验，否则进行灵活推理。训练阶段，Role-Sensitive Process Optimization（RSPO）联合过程优势与终局优势优化策略，Weakness-Driven Demonstration Learning（WDL）针对学生模型的薄弱问题提供经验证的教师示范。推理阶段，Lightweight Adaptive Workflow Reuse（LAWR）选择合适的工作流并绑定当前任务的参数和资源引用；若无合适工作流，则切换到基于 ReAct 的慢路径。系统还根据执行完成情况、工作流采纳情况和成本节省构建无标签反馈，以指导工作流复用和记忆更新。在三项具有挑战性的基准测试中，StarTV-Agent 的相对性能最高提升 8.0%，token 消耗最多降低 52.1%。
key_points_zh: StarTV-Agent 针对两项瓶颈：终局奖励难以指导中间决策与纠错，相似任务的重复规划浪费计算资源。
训练时，RSPO 联合过程优势和终局优势优化策略；WDL 用经验证的教师示范补足学生模型的薄弱题型。
推理时，LAWR 复用合适的工作流并填入当前任务的参数和资源引用；无法复用时，转由 ReAct 逐步推理和调用工具。
执行完成情况、工作流采纳情况和成本节省共同构成无标签反馈，用于指导经验复用与记忆更新。
在三项基准测试中，相对性能最高提升 8.0%，token 消耗最多降低 52.1%。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 系统用角色级轨迹反馈训练策略，并用执行反馈更新未来任务可复用的工作流；消融分别检验策略学习与工作流复用的收益。
agent-harness-evolution.quote:
After execution, the agent updates its workflow memory using our
label-free feedback signals based on execution completion, workflow adoption, and cost savings. This allows
useful execution patterns to be reused and refined over time, reducing the need for repeated planning.

agent-memory.reason: 外部记忆保存带资源依赖的参数化工作流，依据执行反馈调整其复用资格并修订条目；对照实验量化了复用对准确率和令牌成本的影响。
agent-memory.quote:
Workflows with at least Krev consecutive invalid uses are considered for revision. Each revision creates
a new version in advice and suspends the previous one. Completed executions not covered by existing
workflows may generate new candidate workflows. New and revised workflows must pass tool argument
and resource-dependency checks before storage. Memory updates affect only future tasks, allowing reusable
tool-use patterns to improve execution efficiency over time.

agent-multimodal.reason: 视频帧直接进入专家工具编排，视频问答验证集用于比较角色级过程反馈与仅终局奖励；持久记忆保存的是工具流程，而非视频事件本身。
agent-multimodal.quote:
Given a traffic input x (images or video frames) and a question q, StarTV-Agent uses a vision-language policy
πθ to coordinate frozen domain-specific experts E, including detection, segmentation, and attribute recognition
(Appendix E). As shown in Fig. 1, the framework combines ReAct-based tool orchestration, policy learning,
and experience evolution to support complementary slow and fast execution paths.
